evidence_slice: The Planning Inspectorate identifies scheme reference TR010032 as Lower Thames Crossing. The Secretary of State for Transport granted development consent on 25 March 2025. The A122 (Lower Thames Crossing) Development Consent Order 2025 is UKSI 2025/462 and came into force on 15 April 2025. The project is approximately 14.5 miles (23 km), connecting the A2/M2 to the M25 with twin tunnels beneath the River Thames. Planning Inspectorate Application Document 1.3 states that Volume 2 contains location, land, works and related plans for the project.
